items.title: 平行结构的语法对应原则
items.brief: 把并列项提出来，逐项贴同一种语法标签

concept.summary: 平行结构的唯一标准是并列项的语法身份相同：词性相同、短语类型相同、句法功能相同。检查方法是把连词两侧的成分单独提出来各写一行，逐项标出“名词短语 / 不定式 / 动名词 / 从句 / 介词短语”和“作主语 / 宾语 / 表语”，两个标签有一个不同就必须改写。

sections.p: 不要凭语感通读，按步骤把句子拆开，错误会直接暴露在标签上。
bullets: 第一步 找连词：and, or, but, yet，以及逗号连接的三项以上并列
第二步 提取两侧成分，各自单独成行，删去共有的主语和谓语
第三步 贴两个标签：形式（名词/不定式/动名词/从句/介词短语）+ 功能（主语/宾语/表语/定语/状语）
两个标签只要有一个不同，就改写其中一项，而不是改写整句

sections.p: 同一形式内部还要保持细节一致：不定式都带 to 或都不带，从句都用同一个引导词。
bullets: 名词对名词：The course covers grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation.
不定式对不定式：Her plan is to finish the draft and to send it out.
动名词对动名词：Reading aloud and listening to podcasts both help.
从句对从句：He told me that the plan had changed and that we should wait.

sections.p: 词性相同但一个作表语、一个作谓语，仍然不平行。功能标签比形式标签更容易被忽略。
bullets: 词性不同一定不平行：名词短语不能与谓语动词并列
改写为谓语对谓语：She teaches in a high school and coaches the debate team.
作主语的两项：Swimming and cycling are good exercise.
作宾语的两项：She enjoys cooking and baking.

sections.h: 三项以上：每一项都要过检查
sections.p: 三项并列时，错误常藏在最后一项：前两项同形，读者已经形成预期，第三项换了形式最容易被放过。
bullets: 逐项贴标签，不能只看相邻两项
最后一项与前两项形式不同，是最常见的失分点
并列项较长时，先删修饰语，只留中心结构再比对

examples.en: The course covers grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation.
examples.zh: 这门课涵盖语法、词汇和语音。
examples.note: and 连接三个名词，形式与功能都一致，都作 covers 的宾语。

examples.en: Her plan is to finish the draft and to send it out.
examples.zh: 她的计划是写完初稿并把它寄出去。
examples.note: 两个带 to 的不定式并列作表语，形式完全对称。

examples.en: He told me that the plan had changed and that we should wait.
examples.zh: 他告诉我计划变了，我们应该等。
examples.note: 两个 that 引导的宾语从句并列，引导词也保持一致。

examples.en: She teaches in a high school and coaches the debate team.
examples.zh: 她在中学教书，并指导辩论队。
examples.note: 两个谓语动词并列，功能同为谓语，时态人称一致。

examples.en: The job requires patience, accuracy and working hard.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要耐心、准确和努力。
examples.note: 前两项是名词，第三项是动名词短语，形式不一致，应改为 hard work。

examples.en: She is responsible for hiring staff and to train new employees.
examples.zh: 她负责招聘员工和培训新员工。
examples.note: for 后第一项是动名词，第二项却是不定式，应改为 training new employees。

examples.en: To finish the project on time and meeting the budget are both important.
examples.zh: 按时完成项目和不超预算是同样重要的。
examples.note: 并列主语一为不定式一为动名词，应统一为 To finish... and to meet... 或 Meeting... and finishing...

pitfalls.wrong: The film was exciting, well acted and it had a clever ending.
pitfalls.right: The film was exciting, well acted and cleverly plotted.
pitfalls.why: 前两项是形容词性成分作表语，第三项却是完整分句，形式与功能都不一致。

pitfalls.wrong: The new system is faster, cheaper and it is easier to use.
pitfalls.right: The new system is faster, cheaper and easier to use.
pitfalls.why: 前两项是比较级形容词作表语，第三项带了自己的主语和系动词，应压缩成同类形容词短语。

pitfalls.wrong: She is a teacher and teaches in a high school.
pitfalls.right: She is a teacher and a coach at a high school.
pitfalls.why: and 前是名词短语作表语，and 后是谓语动词，功能不同；改成两个名词短语同作表语才平行。

contrast.diff: 本点处理普通连词两侧的成分比对；关联连词还要额外检查两个关联词的位置是否各自对准同类成分。

concept.mnemonic: 提出来、分两行、贴标签；形式与功能，两个都得同。

core: 平行 = 词性相同 + 短语类型相同 + 句法功能相同
三步：找连词、提取两侧成分、贴形式与功能两个标签
三项以上并列，重点查最后一项
表语对表语、谓语对谓语，词性相同也可能功能不同
改写只动不一致的那一项，不重写整句
review.trigger: 看到 and/or/but → 把两侧成分单独写出来 → 各贴一个形式标签和一个功能标签

quickCheck.q: The job requires patience, accuracy and working hard. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 第三项是动名词短语，前两项是名词，应改为 hard work。

quickCheck.q: She is a teacher and teaches in a high school. 为什么不平行？
quickCheck.a: and 前是表语，and 后是谓语，功能不同。

quickCheck.q: 三项并列时最该检查哪一项？
quickCheck.a: 最后一项，它最容易与前两项形式脱节。

drills.stem: The new app is fast, reliable and ___.
drills.explain: and 前是 fast 与 reliable 两个形容词作表语，第三项也必须是形容词性成分，easy to use 是形容词短语。
drills.trap: it is easy to use 自带主语和系动词，变成分句，与前面的形容词不平行；ease of use 是名词短语。

drills.stem: She spends her free time painting, reading and ___ (garden).
drills.hint: 前两项都是动名词，表示活动。
drills.explain: painting 与 reading 都是动名词作 spends 的宾语补足成分，第三项也须用动名词 gardening 才能保持形式一致。

drills.stem: The course helps students to think critically and solving problems independently.
drills.answer: The course helps students to think critically and to solve problems independently.
accept: The course helps students to think critically and to solve problems independently.
The course helps students think critically and solve problems independently.
drills.explain: and 前是带 to 的不定式，后项也应为不定式；改为 to solve 与 to think 对称，或两项都省 to。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The job requires patience, accuracy and stamina.
drills.explain: and 连接三个名词作 requires 的宾语，三项形式与功能一致，构成平行。

drills.stem: 她的目标是写完报告并在周五展示。
drills.answer: Her goal is to finish the report and to present it on Friday.
forbid: and present it on Friday is
drills.explain: 两个不定式并列作表语，第二项保留 to，与第一项 to finish 形式对称。

drills.stem: He told me that the deadline had changed and ___.
drills.explain: and 前是 that 引导的宾语从句，后项也须是 that 从句，两个宾语从句并列作 told 的宾语。
drills.trap: we should start earlier 省略了 that，虽可成立，但与前面的 that 从句在引导词层面不对称；starting 与 to start 则把从句降级成了短语。

items.title: 关联连词引导的平行
items.brief: 关联词的位置决定哪两个成分必须同类

concept.summary: 关联连词成对出现，第二个连词的位置由第一个决定：紧跟 not only、both、either、neither 的成分，必须与紧跟 but also、and、or、nor 的成分同类。改错时先移动关联词的位置，再考虑改动词形式，因为位置错了改形式也救不回来。

sections.p: 同一个句子，not only 放在谓语前还是宾语前，要求完全不同的对称项。先定位置，再检查两侧。
bullets: 谓语对谓语：She not only wrote the report but also designed the charts.
名词对名词：She wrote not only the report but also the charts.
not only 放在谓语前时，but also 后也必须是谓语
not only 置句首时主句倒装，平行关系不变：Not only did she write the report, but she also designed the charts.

sections.p: 每一组都是固定搭配，不能拆开重配，也不能用同义短语顶替其中一个。
bullets: both...and：Both the parents and the teachers were informed.
either...or：You can either call me or send an email.
neither...nor：He neither smokes nor drinks.
not...but：The problem is not money but time.
whether...or：Whether we go or stay is up to you.

sections.p: 破坏平行的方式集中在配对、否定、位置三处，逐一排查即可。
bullets: 配对固定：both 只与 and 配对，not only 只与 but also 配对
neither...nor 已含否定，不能再加 didn't 或 not
位置错位时，but also 后容易变成完整分句，应压成同类形容词
并列项不等长时，先删修饰语再比对中心结构

examples.en: She not only wrote the report but also designed the charts.
examples.zh: 她不仅写了报告，还设计了图表。
examples.note: not only 与 but also 后都是谓语动词，构成谓语对谓语。

examples.en: She wrote not only the report but also the charts.
examples.zh: 她不仅写了报告，还写了图表说明。
examples.note: 关联词移到宾语前，两侧都变成名词短语。

examples.en: He neither smokes nor drinks.
examples.zh: 他既不抽烟也不喝酒。
examples.note: neither 与 nor 后都是第三人称单数谓语，形式对称。

examples.en: The problem is not money but time.
examples.zh: 问题不是钱，而是时间。
examples.note: not 与 but 后都是名词作表语，对照关系清晰。

examples.en: She not only wrote the report but also the charts.
examples.zh: 她不仅写了报告，还有图表。
examples.note: not only 后是谓语 wrote，but also 后是名词 the charts，应把 not only 移到 the report 前。

examples.en: He didn't neither smoke nor drink.
examples.zh: 他既不抽烟也不喝酒。
examples.note: neither...nor 本身已是否定，再加 didn't 构成双重否定，应改为 He neither smoked nor drank.

examples.en: Both the teachers as well as the parents were informed.
examples.zh: 老师和家长都得到了通知。
examples.note: both 只能与 and 配对，as well as 不能充当第二个关联词，应改为 Both the teachers and the parents。

pitfalls.wrong: The course is both useful and it is interesting.
pitfalls.right: The course is both useful and interesting.
pitfalls.why: both 后是形容词 useful，and 后却是完整分句，关联连词两侧必须放同类成分。

pitfalls.wrong: He not only speaks English but also French.
pitfalls.right: He speaks not only English but also French.
pitfalls.why: not only 后是谓语 speaks，but also 后是名词 French；把 not only 移到 English 前，两侧才同为名词。

pitfalls.wrong: She has not neither time nor money.
pitfalls.right: She has neither time nor money.
pitfalls.why: neither...nor 已经承担否定，再加 not 就是双重否定，两个关联词位置也随之被挤乱。

contrast.withTitle: 平行结构的语法对应原则
contrast.diff: 普通连词只需比对两侧成分；关联连词多一步——先确认两个关联词各自的位置，再看它们后面的成分是否同类。

concept.mnemonic: 关联词在谁前面，谁就得跟对面同类。

core: 关联连词两侧成分必须同类，位置由第一个关联词决定
not only 可放在谓语前或宾语前，两侧对称项随之改变
neither...nor 已含否定，不能再加 not 或 didn't
配对不能混用：both 只配 and，not only 只配 but also
review.trigger: 看到 not only/both/either/neither → 先看它紧跟什么成分 → 再要求第二个关联词后也是同类成分

quickCheck.q: He not only speaks English but also French. 怎么改？
quickCheck.a: 改为 He speaks not only English but also French。

quickCheck.q: both 能和 as well as 配对吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，both 只与 and 配对。

quickCheck.q: He didn't neither smoke nor drink. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: neither...nor 已是否定，再加 didn't 构成双重否定。

drills.stem: He ___ smokes nor drinks, which his doctor appreciates.
drills.explain: nor 只能与 neither 配对，构成 neither...nor，两侧都是第三人称单数谓语，形式对称。
drills.trap: either 只能与 or 配对；not 不能与 nor 构成关联结构。

drills.stem: You can either call me ___ send an email.
drills.hint: either 需要一个配对的关联词。
drills.explain: either 只能与 or 配对，or 后接与 call me 同类的动词短语 send an email。

drills.stem: He not only speaks English but also French.
drills.answer: He speaks not only English but also French.
accept: He speaks not only English but also French.
drills.explain: 原句 not only 后是谓语 speaks，but also 后是名词 French，两侧不同类；把 not only 移到 English 前，两侧都成为名词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The problem is not money but time.
drills.explain: not 与 but 后都是名词作表语，形成对照，两侧语法身份一致。

drills.stem: 无论你去还是留，我都支持你。
drills.answer: Whether you go or stay, I will support you.
drills.explain: whether...or 是固定配对，or 两侧的 go 与 stay 同为动词原形，构成平行。

drills.stem: Both the teachers ___ the parents were invited to the ceremony.
drills.explain: both 只能与 and 配对，and 两侧都是名词短语，共同作主语。
drills.trap: as well as 语义接近 but 不能充当 both 的配对词；or 与 nor 会改变 both 的肯定并列意义。

items.title: 平行结构中的省略与不平行错误
items.brief: 省略要覆盖全部并列项，补得回才省

concept.summary: 平行结构允许省掉重复的介词、冠词、助动词和 to，但省略必须覆盖所有并列项：要么每一项都省，要么每一项都留。检查方法是把省掉的词逐个补回，看每个并列项是否都成立；只要有一项补不回，省略就失效。

sections.p: 共享的前提是同一个词能同时管辖所有并列项，且不改变各自的意思。
bullets: 助动词：He has written and revised the report.
不定式符号：She wants to sit down and rest.
介词：He wrote to the manager and the editor.
冠词：the red and white flags（同一批红白旗）/ the red and the white flags（红、白两类旗）

sections.p: 省错的方向只有三种：只省一半、共享了不合适的词、把短语和从句混在一起。
bullets: 只省一半：介词后第二项须同为动名词，如 singing and dancing
共享错词：for 只能管辖名词性成分，planning and running 才补得回 for
层级混排：that 从句不能与名词短语并列，第二项也须是 that 从句

sections.h: 比较结构中的平行省略
sections.p: 比较对象必须同类；省略后要靠 that、those、do 这类替代词保留可比性。
bullets: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.
The winters here are colder than those in the south.
比较对象要同类：人口只能与人口比，须补 that of
同类替代：复数用 those，避免拿汽车与德国比

examples.en: He has written and revised the report.
examples.zh: 他写完并修改了报告。
examples.note: 两个过去分词共用助动词 has，省略只发生在第二项上，补回后完全成立。

examples.en: She wants to sit down and rest.
examples.zh: 她想坐下休息。
examples.note: 两个不定式共用 to，rest 前省去 to，形式仍然平行。

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.
examples.zh: 上海的人口比北京多。
examples.note: that 替代 population，比较对象保持同类，避免拿人口与城市相比。

examples.en: The red and white flags were raised.
examples.zh: 红白两色的旗子升了起来。
examples.note: 一个 the 同时管辖 red and white，指同一批双色旗。

examples.en: She is good at singing and to dance.
examples.zh: 她擅长唱歌和跳舞。
examples.note: at 后第一项是动名词，第二项是不定式，介词无法同时管辖两者，应改为 and dancing。

examples.en: He explained that the rules had changed and the new deadline.
examples.zh: 他解释了规则的变化和新的截止时间。
examples.note: and 前是 that 从句，后是名词短语，层级不一致；应补成 and that the deadline had moved。

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than Beijing.
examples.zh: 上海的人口比北京多。
examples.note: 比较对象错位，人口不能与城市相比，应补 that of Beijing。

pitfalls.wrong: The course helps students to read critically and writing clearly.
pitfalls.right: The course helps students to read critically and to write clearly.
pitfalls.why: 第一项是带 to 的不定式，第二项是动名词，to 无法同时管辖两者；要么都带 to，要么都不带。

pitfalls.wrong: He is responsible for planning and to run the event.
pitfalls.right: He is responsible for planning and running the event.
pitfalls.why: 介词 for 只能管辖名词性成分，planning 成立而 to run 补不回 for，应改为动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: The cars made in Japan are more reliable than Germany.
pitfalls.right: The cars made in Japan are more reliable than those made in Germany.
pitfalls.why: 比较对象必须同类，德国不能与汽车相比，用 those 替代 cars 才能恢复可比性。

contrast.diff: 本点处理并列项共享介词、冠词、助动词与 to 的条件；比较结构另有专门的对称性规则，涉及 more than 与倍数表达。

concept.mnemonic: 省一个就要管全部，补不回就写全。

core: 可共享：介词、冠词、助动词、不定式符号 to
省略必须覆盖全部并列项，不能只省一半
介词只能管辖名词性成分，后面不能混入不定式
从句与名词短语不能并列，层级必须一致
比较结构用 that/those 保留同类比较对象
review.trigger: 看到并列项前只有一个介词或一个 to → 把它分别补到每一项前 → 有一项不成立就改写

quickCheck.q: She is good at singing and to dance. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: at 后第二项应同为动名词，改为 dancing。

quickCheck.q: 省略 to 的前提是什么？
quickCheck.a: 剩下的 to 能同时管辖所有并列的不定式。

quickCheck.q: The population of Shanghai is larger than Beijing. 怎么改？
quickCheck.a: 补 that of，改为 than that of Beijing。

drills.stem: She is responsible for hiring staff and ___ new employees.
drills.explain: 介词 for 后第一项是动名词 hiring，第二项也必须是动名词，for 才能同时管辖两项。
drills.trap: to train 是不定式，介词 for 不能管辖它，补回 for to train 不成立。

drills.stem: He has written and ___ (revise) the report twice.
drills.hint: and 前是过去分词 written，共用助动词 has。
drills.explain: has written 是现在完成时，and 后共用 has，动词须用过去分词 revised，才能与 written 平行。

drills.stem: The course helps students to read critically and writing clearly.
drills.answer: The course helps students to read critically and to write clearly.
accept: The course helps students to read critically and to write clearly.
The course helps students read critically and write clearly.
drills.explain: and 前是带 to 的不定式，后项也应为不定式；统一为 to write，或两项都省 to，省略才能覆盖全部并列项。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.
drills.explain: that 替代前面出现的 population，使比较对象保持同类，避免拿人口与城市相比。

drills.stem: 上海的冬天比北京的冷。
drills.answer: The winters in Shanghai are colder than those in Beijing.
drills.explain: 比较对象是 winters，复数要用 those 替代，才能与前面的 the winters 保持同类。

drills.stem: He explained that the rules had changed and ___.
drills.explain: and 前是 that 引导的宾语从句，后项也须是 that 从句，两个从句并列作 explained 的宾语。
drills.trap: moving 与 to move 把从句降级为短语，与前面的从句层级不同；省略 that 会使并列项在引导词层面不对称。
